threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still call it a 'flat' instead of a 'home' and are puzzled why your mates insist on walking past the bus to get to the Overground.
Heard a bloke on the 60 bus last night arguing with his reflection in the window about whether it was worth catching the last train.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The day I found an entire flock of parrots squawking in the backyard of an old tenement. Just another Neukölln surprise.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you get a public transport strike that feels like everyone suddenly remembers their bikes exist, right before a huge party weekend.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: Only a true local will know to avoid the BART delays and take the 14 Mission to avoid the zoo of confusion at Civic Center. It’s a rite of passage.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus with a whole band on board. They set up for an impromptu jam session – only in the Mission, right?

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think siestas are a total thing here, but few locals actually do it. We just grab a quick nap if we can between jobs and life.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell they still squint in the sun, like it's an alien planet. Locals have perfected the art of ignoring it.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You can tell a newbie by their bewilderment at the London Fields lido's freezing water – all the locals know that's just how it is!
Saw a guy on the 196 bus playing the ukulele at 2 AM. Everyone looked annoyed, but he kept strumming like it was a concert. Strange vibe in Brixton tonight.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: Hearing those late-night kebab shop arguments echoing off the walls while the train rumbles by felt like a rite of passage.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You know it’s Berlin when your bus is delayed because a rave just wrapped up in the middle of the street. Only here does street art and nightlife merge so seamlessly.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by their instinct to dodge the BART delays; tourists just stare at their phones, clueless, when the Civic Center station is shut down.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Saw a guy in a tuxedo try to board the 27 with a pizza box. Muni just stopped, like it was the most normal thing in the world. Classic SF moment.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think the plaza is just for selfies, but it’s where we catch up with friends and hear local bands play on the weekends.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their over-eager use of 'gràcies' every time they get change, even if it's just a coin.
